notes.title: Steam Items: Fixed
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865830/7a8ac59863e34b9e87252d2bb01b23ef922b0110.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]For the past few months you may have noticed that the images for Grow a Carrot's Steam items are missing. [/h3][h3]I was using Imgur to host all the sprites which resulted in Steam not being able to fetch the image from that site after some months of using it. Now the images are being hosted on my GitHub repository and the problem is no more![/h3][p][/p][h1]Before:[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865830/6192eb124c528a6313299b6b810cfd9ae3b75032.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Now:[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865830/95f394d2a5fd129e73d32358a856db27587d4ff2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Some Steam items may still be loading on the Community Market place and the images may not be displayed as small icons. If you experience this problem, waiting a few days should fix the issue itself. If not, please contact me <3[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]
I’ve missed you all.[/h2][h2]Some of you may have missed me too.[/h2][h2]I have big plans in mind, and we will see each other again![/h2][p][/p][p][/p][h2][/h2][h2]In the meantime, not everyone has seen that there is a DLC, so I will drop the link here:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3238280/Detective_Support__Grow_a_Carrot/"][/dynamiclink][/h2][h3](I like the DLC more than the base game :D)[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h1]TAKE CARE EVERYONE![/h1][p][/p][p]and Thank You, for Growing a Carrot... <3[/p]

notes.title: "Find a Carrot" Universe! - Grow a Carrot Major Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865830/391100e8f7279d963257a08a8ad576eb69965f3b.png[/img]

[h1]"Find a Carrot" Universe![/h1]

[h2]Be sure to check the moon, because a new location has appeared there![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865830/ccf216bdedae3cc783adbe38d179510ce4b70d29.png[/img]

[h2]A new location that holds a secret to another Universe!

This Universe works differently than Grow a Carrot. There you have to move using arrow keys.[/h2]
[h3]Be aware of spikes and slimes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865830/66eb1f1a0ff44c603170d9b80d9f1043eb284e80.png[/img]

[h2]Beat all levels and be rewarded with Golden Carrot and Achievement![/h2]
[h3]Golden Carrot gives you 50000 carrots[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865830/4e2dd889355b681be6659394f7b35cd5238b7793.png[/img]



[h1]-----------------------[/h1]

[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]
[h2]I hope everyone is doing great!

I am happy to announce that new update is live!

I added 2 new achievements:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865830/9ada509d23b7aa566e342d46c82a1bc6464c387b.png[/img]

[h2]First one require you just to beat whole "Find a Carrot" Universe

Second one require you to activate all 3 Obelisks, beat "Find a Carrot", then go to "Find a Carrot" again and find Golden Bunny and talk with him.

But be aware, every time you die in a level - it restarts

So if you activated Obelisk and died in the same level. You need to activate it again.[/h2]



[h2]And there is HUGE problem
Please try to avoid sticking to walls! (and ceilings) 
I have no idea why, but whenever you hit wall or ceiling you just stop!
I tried to fix it but somehow I made it even worse...

As soon as I will know how to fix it, I will, I promise.

I designed levels that so you won't hit ceiling or it's not necessary to stay close to the wall, so you should be fine.[/h2]


[h1]-----------------------[/h1]
[h1]
If anyone would like to talk with me, or with other community members, Here's Discord link: [/h1] https://discord.gg/aKMjG9tnrz



[h1]Have a good day Everyone![/h1]
[h3](if there will be any other issues other than sticking to walls, please tell me <3)[/h3]

notes.title: Carrot Slime Boss - Grow a Carrot Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Carrot Slime Boss Update is LIVE![/h2]
[b]Hello everyone! I hope everyone has a good day! Today I was working on a new update where I added few things:[/b]

[h1]- Chemistry Equipment remade | New Dialogs, Buttons, Strength Potion[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865830/5e31484e49a1c1574fe23d1aeb56ebcc8eb9c667.png[/img]

[b]After getting Strength potion you are able to defeat normal carrot slimes with just one click! Also you are strong enough to fight with Carrot Slime Boss! He has 100 HP, and every 3 seconds he is changing his position! The reward for defeating him is 1000 carrots! However, you can fight him once 90 seconds.[/b]

[h1]- Carrot Slime Boss[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865830/e40380ab4e0619f9696dc9560040a1ced5575f47.png[/img]

[h1]- Slime Book[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865830/9051719e6cc8dce90072629078adf2a635494094.png[/img]

[b]Now you can see exactly how many slimes you have defeated![/b]

[h1][b]Small changes:[/b][/h1]

[b]-Fixed Carrot Slime's animation while dying
-Changed cursor in deeper forest to sword
-Now, If you have more than milion carrots, the carrot box in top right corner will expand to fit even more carrots[/b]

[b]If there will be any problems with new update, please write to me ASAP![/b]

[h1]Quick word from developer:[/h1]

[b]Hey everyone, I just want to say that I am reading every review, every discussion and I am looking at every screenshot. And it makes me so happy to see that you guys play my game! Thank you everyone so much![/b]
